summary: Mandatory Absage-Grund feature fully verified end-to-end. All 6 backend pytest cases pass (400 on missing/empty reason, persistence, GET /attendance + overview include reason, zusagen clears reason, invalid status rejected). All frontend UI acceptance criteria pass in mobile viewport: modal opens on Absagen tap with correct placeholder 'z. B. Krank', submit is disabled (aria-disabled=true, opacity=0.6) while empty, tapping empty submit keeps modal open, submitting persists reason, red reason chip 'Grund: <reason>' appears on the event card, re-opening prefills prior reason, cancel keeps state unchanged, switching to Zusagen removes chip, event detail overview shows overview-reason-josh-ankermann with 'Grund: <reason>'. Version 3.0 pill count = 1 on Login (regression OK). Cleanup: josh reset to zugesagt on TR5.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly nulls the reason on zugesagt even if a reason is passed — good defensive behaviour.
Frontend AbsageReasonModal uses opacity 0.6 + disabled prop; on RN Web this renders aria-disabled=true which is testable.
EventCard.absage-reason-<id> chip is a Pressable that reopens the modal for editing — nice UX, prior text is prefilled via initial={reasons[event_id]}.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Josh was toggled on event TR5 during testing and reset to zugesagt at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. If retesting, prefer a Training/Treffen event to avoid touching Spiel data. Frontend prefill on modal re-open works via `initial` prop; verify with input_value() not textContent.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found.
